newsitem.title: USA: Dairy Mart to sell 161 stores, main office.
newsitem.headline: Dairy Mart to sell 161 stores, main office.

text.p: Dairy Mart Convenience Stores Inc said Thursday it agreed to sell its 161 convenience store and gas stations in Connecticut, Massachusetts, Rhode Island, and New York for $39.7 million to DB Cos Inc.
In a separate deal, the company agreed to sell its former headquarters in Enfield, Conn., to Realty Venture Capital Partners of Stamford, Conn., for $4.2 million.
Dairy Mart is relocating its headquarters to northeastern Ohio, where it has its greatest presence of assets, it said.
Dairy Mart said both transactions are expected to close this spring.
Dairy Mart will lease back a portion of its former headquarters to house an accounting and information systems processing center, but other terms were not disclosed.
Dairy Mart's strongest concentration of stores is in the Midwest with 650, 400 of them in Ohio.
Proceeds of the sales will be used to accelerate its $100 million store improvement plan, Dairy Mart said.
